value.rationale: This is the natural complete finite-sample support of the fixed-point statistic from recent Poisson-approximation work. It gives exact extreme values, a universal one-mismatch gap, a two-color parity phase, and a gap-free spectrum for three or more symbols, with a linear-time witness. These are structural distributional facts beyond a numerical table or moment formula.
